subject: afi-2
title: AFI(2)--------ATTN.
description: Second diagram on page 394 (JR-16), paired with AFI-2 × STY above. Where the first diagram crosses affinity-insight second-degree with style, this one names what AFI-2 meets when attraction is the working partner — the question of how jazz-rock's actual second-degree-insight reaches the listener's attention: AFI-2 crossed with ATTN (attraction). AFI-2 sits on the right with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs down-left to ATTN; TRS (transition) at top-center branches from the main line, and SPT-GH (spiritual growth) at upper-right branches from RT-DY's line. SOC-RT-DEVL (social-reality development) at upper-left branches from TRS's line, with SG (source initiation) below off SOC-RT-DEVL's line. RT-DY (reality dynamics) branches from the main line to the right; STY (style) sits centrally off RT-DY's line, and WO-UNF (world-unification) branches from SPT-GH's line. ATTN sits at lower-left as partner-axis. INFO-DOC (information documentation) drops from the main line to the bottom; POL-DY (political dynamics) at lower-center branches from INFO-DOC's line and REL-APC (relevant application) from POL-DY's line.
